name: Tarski truth definition and model theory
summary: A semantic definition of truth in formal languages gave the basis for the study of models of theories.

name: Topological degree methods for nonlinear PDE (Leray-Schauder)
summary: Brouwer's degree is extended to compact perturbations of the identity in Banach spaces, giving existence results for nonlinear partial differential equations.

name: Covering surfaces and value distribution (Ahlfors)
summary: Nevanlinna's value distribution theory is given a topological and geometric proof through covering surfaces and length-area arguments.

name: Matroid theory and combinatorial geometry
summary: Whitney's abstraction of dependence unites linear algebra and graphs.

name: Sobolev generalised solutions
summary: Weak derivatives and function spaces were introduced to treat generalised solutions of wave and elliptic equations.

name: Fibre bundles and characteristic classes join topology and differential geometry
summary: Stiefel-Whitney, Pontryagin and Chern classes are defined on bundles and computed by curvature, giving global invariants of manifolds.

name: Combinatorial theory as incidence algebra and Mobius inversion (Rota)
summary: The Mobius function of the integers is generalised to partially ordered sets, giving a unified framework for inclusion-exclusion, counting and lattice theory.

name: Computer science separates from mathematics
summary: Computability, switching theory and programming grow into a discipline with its own departments, journals and questions (complexity, algorithms) while keeping heavy mathematical exchange.
